7e170dd713c76fd3.rationale: The template string builds a `<SECRET_N>` / `<TYPE_N>` redaction placeholder label for test-fixture comparison or CLI output text; it is never assigned to `innerHTML`, rendered into a DOM, or otherwise interpreted as markup, so the XSS this rule guards against cannot occur here.

fdf3fdaea249e3e5.rationale: `scenario[role] = ...` writes to a scenario object this file creates itself, and `role` is checked against the literal allowlist `setup`/`run`/`serve`/`expect` a few lines above, so the key can never be `__proto__`, `constructor`, or `prototype`. The input is this repository's own `docs/quickstart.md`, read by a local qualification script. It is not a network-facing service.

8b8fd1cd3925ff77.rationale: The dynamic lookup selects a lane function from a literal three-entry object (`node`/`python`/`browser`); `options.lane` is validated against the fixed `LANES` list during argument parsing, before this call, so the invoked function is always one of the three lane functions defined in this file, never externally controlled. This is a local qualification script, not a network-facing service.

33109d3a53487fd7.rationale: The URL is built from a fixed, hardcoded registry host (registry.npmjs.org, crates.io, or pypi.org) with only a package name and the throwaway version path-appended; the host is never attacker-influenced, so this cannot be redirected to an untrusted origin.

d9eb2b7115201b31.rationale: The dynamic lookup selects a lane function from a literal three-entry object (`node`/`python`/`browser`); `options.lane` is validated against the fixed `LANES` list during argument parsing, before this call, so the invoked function is always one of the three lane functions defined in this file, never externally controlled. 4240b15f2c8c9d92.rationale: The maintainer-local PII identity evaluation example reads `env::args().skip(1)`, discarding argv[0], and accepts one option: --family, whose value must name one of the six closed production PII family ids or the example exits with an error. Arguments are never interpreted as a command, passed to a shell, used to launch a process, or used for an authorization decision, and the example is outside every published package, so neither the argv[0] nor the command-argument injection concern this generic rule targets applies.

30911d02b54979a8.rationale: The maintainer-local scan_cost bench parses its own flags (--runs, --filter, --json, --no-detectors, --top, --list) from its arguments to choose which synthetic workloads to time and how to print them. They are never interpreted as a command, passed to a shell, or used to launch another process, and the bench is outside every published package, so the command-argument injection class reported by this generic rule is absent.

fde6ed285a470997.rationale: Documentation example (examples/configuration-ownership): the first `console.log` argument is the joined action names of a comparison, each one of the four fixed values allow/warn/redact/block produced by the library, printed to the local terminal; no format directive from external input is interpreted and the output is never used as a format string.

2900e7eed2993d0d.rationale: The argument list is built as a list and never passed to a shell. 3c7eb5f395907db3.rationale: The URL is built from a fixed, hardcoded registry host (pypi.org, crates.io, or registry.npmjs.org) with only a package/crate name path-appended; the host is never attacker-influenced, so this cannot be redirected to an untrusted origin.

4646ac9f1c5791b2.rationale: The pattern comes from the checked-in handoff JSON Schema (`docs/contracts/contribution/implementation-ready-handoff-v1.schema.json`), which is reviewed repository content, not request data. d27291320a54fbdd.rationale: The interpolated detector id is validated by `ID_PATTERN` (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$`) before any edit runs, so it holds no regular-expression metacharacters (a `-` outside a character class is literal). The script is a local contributor tool, not a service.

f8d19894a7ed57b5.rationale: The interpolated group is checked against the fixed `GROUPS` list (`ai`, `cloud`, `devtools`, `pkg-registry`, `saas`) before use, so it holds no regular-expression metacharacters. The script is a local contributor tool, not a service.

5ee1ef66780ff9ec.rationale: The template string is the CLI `--help` usage text, containing `<detector-id>`-style placeholders for the terminal. It is printed to stdout, never assigned to `innerHTML`, rendered into a DOM, or interpreted as markup.
